item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `supported_params` to include `response_format` only on the two capable variants, and verifies the plain variant receives no `response_format` kwarg."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"The `json_mode_lm` variant sets `supported_params` true and `supports_response_schema` false, then asserts `response_format == {\"type\": \"json_object\"}`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"The `structured_lm` variant advertises both capabilities and asserts the captured `response_format` is a subclass of `pydantic.BaseModel`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"`forward` captures `**kwargs` into `self.calls` and returns an OpenAI chat-completion-shaped fake response whose message content is a JSON string."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Instantiates three LM variants, runs the same `dspy.Predict` with `dspy.JSONAdapter` through each, and asserts/prints schema class vs JSON mode vs absent hint."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
